direction.description: Outbound: kernel-initiated. Inbound: outside-initiated. Bidirectional: long-lived with traffic both ways.

target_category.description: Category of the outside target. v1.1 §11 ships with `network` only.

target_identifier.description: Identifier kernel does not interpret beyond policy matching and audit (typically a URL).

payload.description: Opaque payload body; passed to the outside service. Hashed at queue time (post-classification-transform if applicable).

for_ir_id.description: (I, R) id this outside call is performed for; used for provenance, authority resolution, and tier-3 event linkage.

authorization_id.description: Standing authorization (I, R) id permitting the call. Required when policy gates the call.

priority.description: Opaque integer; kernel passes to queue scheduler. Higher integer = higher priority.

expires_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp; latest acceptable service time. Kernel drops queued calls with EXPIRES_AT_PASSED if cutoff elapses before service.

store_payload_sidecar.description: When true (and policy permits), store full request and response payloads under .8os/payloads/<event-id>.{request,response}. Default off; payloads exist only as hashes.
